## Problem

## Change

## Verification

- [ ] New or changed behavior has a focused test.
- [ ] No credentials, real store data, workbooks, product assets, logs, or browser profiles are included.
- [ ] The `save_delist` and stop-gate safety boundaries remain intact, or the security impact is explicitly reviewed.

## External impact
